description: Free. Full details for one part: provider specs, price, stock and lifecycle, the per-MPN structured values (specialized_specs), the cached datasheet summary, and datasheet_status with available_sections when ready. If any of it is for a different MPN than you asked for (an orderable variant, a base part, a sibling's datasheet), resolved_as and data_quality_warning at the top of the response say so, and prose written for another part is labelled as such at the start of datasheet_summary (family_summary with compact=true): trust specialized_specs for numbers. prefetch_datasheet=true starts extraction at no extra charge. Use after search_parts to drill into one result. datasheet_status: 'ready' → read it; 'extracting' / 'queued' / 'pending' / 'resolving' → poll check_extraction_status; 'not_extracted' → prefetch_datasheets; 'no_source' / 'unsupported' → request_datasheet_upload. Full list in the server instructions.

compact.description: Return the shorter answer: prose written for another part comes back as family_summary instead of a labelled datasheet_summary. Default false: the full answer.

part_number.description: Specific manufacturer part number (MPN) or LCSC number (e.g. 'TPS54302DDCR', 'C2837938'). Not a value ('100nF'), description or reference designator ('R1').

prefetch_datasheet.description: Start background datasheet extraction (no extra charge).

verbose.description: Return every available_sections entry. By default the first 50 are returned, plus a '_truncated' entry saying how many more exist.

name: get_part_details
title: Get Part Details
